observations.fact: Closing managed-investor payable 5,284,485,167,173 VND; opening comparative 2,362,663,075,403 VND. Included within on-balance transaction payables.
observations.proves: Recognized liability, amount and program caption
observations.doesNotProve: Interest-bearing nature, use as issuer financing, segregated fiduciary terms, or exact return/principal contract

observations.fact: Other operating expense is 588,947,224,663 VND, covering Két Vàng and several other programs. Only a separate 266,750,000 VND receivables provision is itemized; no exact Két Vàng cost allocation.
observations.proves: Mixed expense bucket includes program costs
observations.doesNotProve: Két Vàng-only interest/return expense or its rate; no subtraction or proportional allocation performed

observations.fact: Borrowing interest 609,169,047,616 VND comprises bond interest 273,816,742,673 and short-loan interest 335,352,304,943.
observations.doesNotProve: Mixed note-28 cost is interest, or absence of a financing obligation outside the reported borrowing caption

observations.fact: Operating row 50 is an aggregate 2,519,094,220,855 VND payable movement. Financing receipts/repayments are generic borrowing flows. Customer brokerage/entrustment flows are a separate section.
observations.doesNotProve: Program-specific receipt, repayment, return-paid classification or exact closing debt. Neither aggregate movement nor borrowing flows are substituted for the closing payable

observations.fact: Transaction payable 5,305,624,911,458 VND is within the broad financial-liability table, in the up-to-one-year bucket. This aggregate contains the managed-investor payable.
observations.proves: On-balance financial-liability presentation and aggregate maturity bucket
observations.doesNotProve: Canonical interest-bearing financing, demand terms or an exact Két Vàng-only maturity/return obligation

observations.fact: FY2022 comparative row remains 5,284,485,167,173 VND; footnote identifies over 5,273 billion VND of managed Két Vàng funds and cessation on 24 May 2023.
observations.proves: Prior managed-program cessation and a rounded comparative population description
observations.doesNotProve: An exact 5,273-billion financing portion, an exact residual, or entire-row contractual homogeneity

observations.locator: PDF page 42, note 19(ii), and page 53, note 30(i)
observations.fact: iSave customer borrowings start on 24 May 2023; the mixed program-cost note also identifies earlier Két Vàng program cessation that date.
observations.proves: Temporal transition between two disclosed accounting populations
observations.doesNotProve: Unchanged FY2022 contracts, legal/economic equivalence, novation, retrospective borrowing classification, or exact migration of the closing FY2022 population

observations.fact: Issuer describes pre-2023 Két Vàng iSave branding, daily returns, 24/7 deposits/withdrawals and trading buying-power integration. Page 5 says up to 7% annually; page 9 gives 4.5%-6.0%.
observations.proves: Historical brand continuity and described product features
observations.doesNotProve: A fixed or guaranteed contractual rate, issuer principal/return guarantee, full closing-balance coverage or unchanged contracts across 24 May 2023

observations.locator: PDF pages 20-33 accounting policies, particularly page 28 note 4.17
observations.fact: General accounting policies describe payables/accruals; no specific FY2022 Két Vàng contract-to-population reconciliation was established in this review.
observations.doesNotProve: Managed-asset fiduciary separation or financing nature of the questioned population

questions.principalDepositedOrInvested: Investor funds/recognized payable are evidenced; exact principal versus accrued-return composition is not separately established.
questions.contractualReturn: Daily product returns described by issuer annual report; FY2022 binding terms across the full closing population not established.
questions.guaranteedReturn: NOT_ESTABLISHED; marketing yield is not a contractual guarantee.
questions.principalRepaymentObligation: Recognized payable supports an obligation to settle; exact contractual principal recourse against TCBS for the full population not established.
questions.demandWithdrawal: 24/7 withdrawal described in FY2022 annual report; full-population binding withdrawal/settlement terms not established.
questions.maturity: Aggregate transaction payable is up to one year in liquidity table; Két Vàng-specific contractual maturity not separately proven.
questions.issuerCreditExposure: On-balance liability presentation proven; exact investor recourse and loss allocation not established.
questions.fiduciaryArrangement: Managed caption alone does not prove a fiduciary-only arrangement.
questions.offBalanceClientProperty: Not the accounting presentation of the questioned on-balance payable; no automatic classification as ordinary off-balance client money.
questions.onBalanceFinancialLiability: PROVEN by FY2022 note 18 and liquidity table; broader than canonical interest-bearing financial debt.
questions.borrowingCharacteristics: Daily return and withdrawal are suggestive but not sufficient contractual/full-population proof.
questions.owedPrincipalAndFixedReturnDirectly: NOT_ESTABLISHED from binding FY2022 contract terms.
questions.assetSegregation: Generic client transaction segregation remains protected; no program-specific FY2022 asset segregation established for this payable.
questions.recognizedAsBorrowingAnotherPeriod: Separate iSave borrowing disclosure begins 24 May 2023; retrospective contract/population bridge unproven.
questions.programStructureChange2023: Earlier managed program ceased and customer borrowing population began on 24 May 2023. Same pre-existing iSave branding proven; exact legal/economic relationship remains unresolved.
